[[Spiritspeaker]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Wagg Spiritspeak]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Ferndale]].


==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Channeling Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Channeling Rod (forked)]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Ritualist Cane]] from collector [[Kolpp]] or crafter [[Honglei Sun]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[wand]]s:
**[[Ritualist Cane]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scepter]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Seize the Day]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
[[Shakahm's Striker]] has stats identical to this item.
